def.brief: Environment for this run: this machine's overlay sets settings.chongdae.commit-records to false, so raw run records (worker answers that may hold machine paths) are written locally and not committed until a reviewed public projection exists; ownership, guards and review stay enabled. The project's hunsu environment declaration and lock from the bootstrap session are adopted here so they can be committed apart from any record.

non-claims: no check decides this task; done means the agent said so

adopted.why: The project's hunsu environment (declaration, lock, judge's judgments, enabled plugins) was written by the earlier bootstrap session before this run existed and is untracked; the owner's task brief names environment adoption among what this run may commit. Adopted by the session; the hunsu resolutions inside stay reviewed:false, as written.

trace.command-lines: kept in the local session transcript, not in the record
